nodes.label: Hoist Static JSX Elements
nodes.rationale: Extracting static JSX to module scope avoids re-creating the element tree on every render — especially valuable for large static SVG nodes. With React Compiler enabled, manual hoisting is unnecessary. Impact: LOW.

nodes.label: React Compiler
nodes.rationale: When enabled, the React Compiler automatically memoizes, hoists static JSX, and optimizes dependency tracking — making manual memo()/useMemo() hoisting and some dependency tuning unnecessary.
